name: Borgo Maggiore (San Marino)
description: Divided horizontally white over light blue, with the arms of Borgo Maggiore in the centre and the name BORGO MAGGIORE written vertically at the hoist.
history: The castello's arms on the white-over-light-blue bicolour of San Marino, with the castello's name written vertically at the hoist.

features.role: arms of Borgo Maggiore: three towers and a house, lettered LIBERTAS
